title: 45th Annual Lotus Festival Celebrates Sri Lankan Culture at Echo Park Lake
description:
Colorful performances, incredible food, and vibrant traditions took over Echo Park Lake as Los Angeles celebrated the 45th Annual Lotus Festival, honoring Sri Lanka as this year's featured host country.

The Lotus Festival is one of Los Angeles' longest-running cultural celebrations, bringing together communities from across the city for a weekend of live performances, traditional dance and music, authentic cuisine, cultural exhibits, and family-friendly activities. This year's festival highlights the rich heritage of Sri Lanka while celebrating the diversity that makes Los Angeles one of the world's most multicultural cities.

Hear from City leaders, community members, and Sri Lankan representatives as they reflect on the importance of preserving cultural traditions, sharing them with future generations, and creating opportunities for Angelenos to learn from one another. From food and entertainment to cultural exchange and community pride, the Lotus Festival showcases how Los Angeles continues to bring people together through shared experiences.

Learn more about the Lotus Festival at:
http://www.lotusfestivalla.com/
